title: APAC RAG latency & provider pricing reconnaissance for enterprise RAG deployments
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Objective: Produce a decision-ready brief for Sales & Product about latency vs cost trade-offs for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) deployments across major APAC cloud regions and managed vector stores. Scope includes 3 representative RAG architectures (hosted embedding + vector DB, dedicated inference + local vector store, and hybrid with edge vector cache), evaluation across 4 APAC cloud regions (ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-south-1, asia-east1), and unit-economics modelling for enterprise SLAs (99.9% availability, 100ms tail latency target for query path).

Deliverables:
- Executive brief (1-pager) summarizing primary trade-offs and recommended go-to-market messaging for RD and Sales.
- Technical appendix with empirical latency histograms, cost-per-query breakdown (tokens + embedding + retrieval + vector db ops), and test harness scripts.
- Runbook for recommended routing & model selection policy for APAC customers (cost-first vs latency-first profiles).

Methodology and test plan:
- Benchmarks will use three consumer RAG stacks: 1) Hosted Redwood embeddings + managed vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate) + hosted Redwood generation; 2) Dedicated Redwood inference + customer-hosted vector DB in same region; 3) Hybrid with edge caching (KV cache + pre-warmed retrieval nodes).
- For each stack, test 4 sequence lengths (64, 256, 1024, 2048 tokens) and three query arrival patterns (steady 10 qps, 100 qps burst, burst with cold cache). 50th, 95th, and 99th percentiles recorded.
- Cost model includes per-token generation, embedding calls, vector DB read/write ops, network egress, and reserved capacity amortization for Dedicated scenarios.
- Empirical tests run from 3 rooftops: Tokyo, Singapore, Mumbai to capture ISP and cloud-region variance.

Acceptance criteria:
- Latency and cost curves for each architecture and region uploaded to the shared spreadsheet.
- A recommendation for 2 default APAC profiles (Latency-First and Cost-First) with suggested model variants and routing priorities.
- Identified risks and mitigation steps for data residency, estimated SLA uplift cost, and required infra changes.

Stakeholders: Sales APAC (MKT-APAC), Enterprise Solutions (Anya Chen), Infra Eng (ENG-5021), Research (Dmitri Volk), Legal (for data residency notes).

Notes and constraints: We will not benchmark on-prem air-gapped deployments in this task. Vector DB vendor pricing is variable; use published list prices + quoted discounts where available. Make explicit any assumptions about egress or partner discounts in the appendix.
